candidate_rule: normalize each patch-attention embedding, average the last four strictly-past accepted proposals within 1500 frames, normalize the prototype, and use cosine cost
selection: All six videos and three registered source-matched seeds are fixed before labels are opened; no threshold, seed, video, history mode, or outer metric is selected.
hypothesis: A supervised DINO patch-attention embedding may preserve identity detail that the fitted global embedding removes; first measure same-graph correction/harm and fixed-margin complementarity before any combination replay.
predeclared_margin_gate: On each clean row with at least two patch-valid legal edges, use patch attention only when its top-two appearance-cost margin is strictly greater than the fitted-global embedding margin; otherwise retain fitted embedding. No learned or fitted threshold.
promotion_gate: A combination replay is permitted only if patch-attention corrections exceed harms against embedding on every registered video and the fixed margin gate has positive correction-minus-harm on every registered video; otherwise record a diagnostic negative boundary and run no combination.
scope: Read-only retrospective same-input candidate-edge complementarity audit. The accepted fitted-global tracker predictions and causal histories are reused byte-for-byte; patch attention is evaluated only as a fixed appearance coordinate on that graph. Physical labels are opened only after all 18 accepted prediction and trace hashes are locked. No GT, physical identity, future frame, teacher, external payload or cached inference feature enters online replay.

guards.raw_fps: not measured; retrospective native association audit only
